experiment.target_selection: Per robot: highest geometric-Jacobian sigma_min of 300 seed-controlled samples in the middle 50% of model joint ranges.
experiment.scope: Four representative targets and four feasible Cartesian segments; not a workspace benchmark or hardware validation.
